**Position:** Postdoctoral Researcher at Sciences Po

Researcher exploring the intersection of economic history and political science, with a focus on the historical evolution and political role of central banking.


## Publications

Lupi, Mattia. (2026). [How Credit Policy Ends: Central Bankers and the Rise and Fall of Credit Controls in Italy, 1973–1983](https://doi.org/10.1017/S0960777325000025). *Contemporary European History*, 35.

Lupi, Mattia. (2024). [A European Credit Council? Lessons from the History of Italian Central Banking after World War II](https://doi.org/10.1515/ael-2022-0071). *Accounting, Economics, and Law: A Convivium*, 14(4): 533--551.
